data.name: Dup_Intro
data.value: Files on local drives with the same size are compared by their content: first the first 64 KB, then the whole file (SHA-256). Files that are only in the cloud are never read, and hard links to the same file count once. Reading runs with low priority and can be cancelled at any time. Shares are only looked up in the directory; nothing on the server is opened.

data.name: Dup_LocalHint
data.value: Each group holds files with exactly the same content. Mark the copies you do not need; at least one file of every group always stays unmarked. Files on removable drives can be compared but not moved.

data.name: Dup_SharesHint
data.value: Possible duplicates, not checked: these files only have the same name and size according to the directory. Their contents were not compared, and nothing on the server was read. Check them yourself before deleting anything; there is no delete function for shares here.

data.name: Ocr_Intro
data.value: FileDetective can read the text in the images of chosen local folders, such as your screenshots, and find the images by it: press Tab in the search bar until “Image text”. The text recognition built into Windows does this offline, nothing leaves the computer. Images on network shares and files that are only in the cloud are never read.

data.name: Ocr_NoLanguage
data.value: Windows has no text recognition for the languages of your profile, so no image can be read. To add it without administrator rights: Windows Settings > Time & language > Language & region, open the options of your language (or add it) and install “Optical character recognition”. Then restart FileDetective.

data.name: Ocr_FoldersHint
data.value: Only local folders. A folder that lies in no location is added as a location of its own. Removing a folder deletes the recognized text of its images at once; its location stays. Read are PNG, JPEG, BMP, GIF and TIFF files from 5 KB to 50 MB.
